capability.name: MCP tool-set diff with rug-pull signals
capability.description: Diffs two tools/list results of one MCP server: tools added and removed, a word diff of each changed description, the schema paths and annotations that moved. Raises signals only on what a change ADDED: new addresses, instruction tags, 'do not tell the user', credential paths, hidden Unicode, references to other tools, read-only or closed-world hints dropped, new URL/command/path parameters.

old.description: the approved tools/list result (a list, or {tools})

new.description: the current tools/list result of the same server

note: rug-pull check for an MCP server you already approved
